question: Does the frozen BG retain its overall mean/P90 gain and reveal the reproducibility of the development HOLD groups under twelve new joint arrival/service seed blocks?

population.seed_pairing: Zip twelve new arrival and service seeds in declared order; disjoint from development seeds 300001-300003/400001-400003.

measurement_support.action_roster: Retain all 35 supported native complete-frame actions: 27 dedicated and 8 loaded. Preserve each of the four catalogues' three native job scales, requirements, lane counts and excluded actions.
measurement_support.training: Use only each source gate's accepted waves1..12 and its exact source_artifacts/correction_artifacts. Do not add old excluded or unsafe attempts. Never filter a wave/action by new scheduler performance.
measurement_support.holdout: Keep wave13 components separate. Do not use them in fitting the mean catalogue or sampling the primary empirical distribution, or to choose a model/action/threshold. They support phase-model diagnostics, not physical complete-action holdout validation.
measurement_support.dedicated: Preserve each wave's child-aggregate initialization, native-unit loop time and finalization as one record; reconstruct the original native job size by the existing complete-frame composition rule.
measurement_support.loaded: Keep target phase and resident conservative overlap service from the same accepted loaded row together. Combine that row with a dedicated resident p1 training-wave phase by the existing initialization/overlap/residual-drain/finalization rule. Empty and loaded campaigns have separate dates: their Cartesian product assumes independence across campaigns.
measurement_support.replication_unit: A loaded12x12 product supplies144 derived support points from12 loaded and12 dedicated phase waves; it does not supply144 independent physical executions. Per-wave resident conservative overlap estimates are not raw instantaneous rate observations.

mean_catalogue_and_load.policy_catalogue: Both policies see one catalogue with each action's E[max(1,duration)] and the mean of every jointly retained native-job completion-offset slot, fitted only to training support.
mean_catalogue_and_load.arrival_rates: Recompute the original capacity LP direction and .8/.95 loads using requirements/E[max(1,duration)]. Do not use E[requirements/duration] or legacy rates. Generate each literal independent-Poisson arrival tape once and reuse it across both policies and both execution conditions.
mean_catalogue_and_load.mean_condition: Execute the fitted mean duration/offset vector supplied to the policies.
mean_catalogue_and_load.empirical_condition: Sample a whole fitted support record at each action admission and reserve max(1,its duration). No artificial jitter, time normalization, per-coordinate resampling or mean-service correction is added.

policy_and_information.algorithm: Unchanged BG S1/S2 root selection, MW continuation, queue envelope, FIFO population, overflow fallback and observed-count/now arrival estimate. MaxWeight uses exact single-lane enumeration on the same mean catalogue.
policy_and_information.window: Mean-catalogue tau_max; no true arrival rates, real future arrival tape, service samples, service seed, evaluation horizon or hidden release times enter the policy.
policy_and_information.busy_lane_forecast: Use max(now,last nominal release time) for a still-busy lane and now for an observed released lane. A busy overdue lane has zero forecast residual; this is mean-model prediction error, not knowledge of its real release time. Actual sampled release times determine environment events only.
policy_and_information.clock: Actual service clock with one-second idle polling and complete loaded lane reservations. Computation is recorded separately and does not delay service.

service_pairing.stream_rule: Each policy arm creates its own fresh EmpiricalServiceTape with the same paired seed; never share a mutable tape between arms. One environment-only Python Random stream per action_id is seeded with seed_rule + ':action:' + action_id. The nth use of the same action receives the same whole support record across policies, regardless of lane or intervening other-action draws.
service_pairing.scope: Policies can select different actions and action counts. Pair the exogenous indexed streams and literal births, not realized job completion times or different action histories.

outcomes.primary: 1200-second birth-cohort restricted mean flow, BG minus MW, in the empirical condition.
outcomes.secondary: Same-pair common completed-ID P90 and900/1200 unfinished counts. Recompute common populations separately for each BG/MW condition; never pool completed jobs or transfer one condition's P90 population to another.
outcomes.variability_contrast: Empirical-minus-mean change in the paired BG-minus-MW effect, using all24 matched arrival tapes.
outcomes.retention: Report both conditions, all eight catalogue/load groups, all24 workload classes, all three complete joint seed blocks, every paired tape and actual algorithm work. Keep all regressions and HOLD outcomes.

performance_gates.application: Apply the original numerical gates separately to mean and empirical execution; neither condition overrides a HOLD in the other or in prior experiments.

statistics: Twelve complete joint arrival/service-seed blocks, not384 independent observations. This is independent confirmation conditional on the frozen phase-derived service bank and planning streams; report all groups/classes and apply the original gates separately to mean and empirical conditions. Do not pool these blocks with the three development blocks, compute new intervals, or automatically adopt on a PASS.
execution: Freeze the development BG implementation, fitted catalogue, service bank, arrival-rate calibration, planning rule, budgets and gates. Generate twelve fresh paired arrival/service blocks and execute both conditions and both policies on every literal tape. Keep all trajectories on the server and pull only small receipts/summary.
limitations: This is a measured-phase-derived stochastic complete-frame model with an explicit cross-campaign independence assumption. It is not a measured joint distribution of full native loaded-action executions, a live placement result, a random-service stability theorem or an actual P90 guarantee. Original BG confirmation, planning-stream results and all prior HOLD outcomes remain unchanged. Development HOLD remains separate and is not pooled with this confirmation.
